> GitHub is currently the public replica of the authoritative CDC GitLab
> repository. Please propose code changes through a GitLab merge request so the
> histories do not diverge. See `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `AGENTS.md`.

## External contribution

Describe the proposed change and link the corresponding GitLab issue or merge
request. A maintainer can help route an external proposal into the authoritative
workflow without independently merging GitHub `main`.
